# package apdu

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet/apdu"
```

Package apdu implements BACnet Application Protocol Data Unit framing.

apdu understands PDU structure, service choice and raw service payload only. It does not decode ReadProperty, Who-Is or COV payload structure.

Strict BACnet/IP uses a framing decoder: reserved header bits, undefined MaxAPDU codes, MoreFollows without SegmentedMessage, and zero/out-of-range segment windows are rejected as ErrMalformed.

apdu is a sibling wire codec: it may import github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet but must not import bvlc or npdu. Payload may alias the input buffer.

### func DecodeErrorClassCode

### type ErrorDetail

```go
type ErrorDetail struct {
	Class uint16
	Code  uint16
	// Wrapped is true when the Error was carried as a constructed [0] wrapper.
	Wrapped bool
	// Parameters are the elements after the [0] wrapper, in wire order. They
	// own their memory (deep copy) and are nil for a bare Error.
	Parameters []bacnet.Element
}
```

ErrorDetail is a decoded Error PDU service payload.

Most services carry a bare Error (class and code). WritePropertyMultiple, CreateObject, AddListElement, RemoveListElement, ConfirmedPrivateTransfer, VT-Close and SubscribeCOVPropertyMultiple instead wrap it as error-type \[0] and append service-specific parameters; Wrapped reports that form and Parameters holds the elements that follow the wrapper.

#### func DecodeError

```go
func DecodeError(payload []byte, limits bacnet.DecodeLimits) (ErrorDetail, error)
```

DecodeError parses an Error PDU service payload in either the bare form (two application ENUMERATEDs, or the context \[0]/\[1] pair some peers emit) or the wrapped form used by the services listed on ErrorDetail.

#### func (ErrorDetail) FirstFailedElementNumber

```go
func (d ErrorDetail) FirstFailedElementNumber() (uint32, bool)
```

FirstFailedElementNumber returns first-failed-element-number \[1] of a CreateObject-Error or ChangeList-Error (AddListElement, RemoveListElement). It reports false when the parameter is absent or not an Unsigned32. The result is only meaningful for those services: other wrapped errors assign a different meaning to context tag 1.

#### func EncodeMaxSegments

```go
func EncodeMaxSegments(count int) MaxSegmentsCode
```

EncodeMaxSegments maps a segment count limit to the wire code. count 0 means unspecified. The code never over-advertises relative to count: a limit of 3 encodes as 2 (not 4). Values above 64 encode as GT64.
